description.value: Wendy's is a major North American fast-food chain known for its square, fresh-never-frozen beef burgers, the iconic Frosty dessert, and year-round chili. This location offers outdoor seating and takeout, making it a serviceable calorie stop for touring cyclists moving through the area east of Vancouver. The full menu includes burgers, chicken sandwiches, salads, baked potatoes, and breakfast items.
